title: Classify vessel presence and estimate length from 80×80 dual-pol SAR tiles
description: For each CFAR detection, extract an 80×80 pixel SAR tile centered on the detection and preserving both VH and VV polarization bands. Apply a single-input, multi-output CNN (ResNet-based) that outputs (1) probability of object presence and (2) estimated object length. Use this to filter out false CFAR detections and estimate vessel length.

inputs.cfar_detections: CFAR anomalies with scene reference and coordinates

outputs.confirmed_vessels: Detections with vessel probability and estimated length
